title: Subarray Problems
definition: A subarray is a contiguous part of an array. Subarray problems typically require Sliding Window (if all numbers are positive) or Prefix Sum arrays (if numbers can be negative).
simpleExplanation: Taking a slice of a loaf of bread. The slice must be continuous; you can't skip pieces in the middle.

answers.question: **Basic:** Write a function to implement the core logic of Subarrays.
**Intermediate 1:** Optimize Subarrays to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative numbers.
**Intermediate 2:** Solve a standard interview variation of Subarrays (e.g. LeetCode Medium).
**Advanced:** Scale Subarrays for massive datasets or implement it recursively.
**Expert/FAANG:** Solve Subarrays in O(1) space or O(N) time when constraints are extremely tight.
